notes: src/ vs dist/ inside each package are build-artifact duplicates of the same snippet; src is treated as canonical.
motion-atlas/motion-atlas-creative-53-60.zip is a zipped copy of the 8 files also extracted into motion-atlas-creative-53-60/motion-atlas/snippets/ (artifact duplication).
motion-atlas/snippets/PROMPT.md and README.md are meta files, not snippets.

duplicate_clusters.differs: Same stage scaffold + palette; cursor trail family. spring-trail: one springy radial-gradient blob chasing the cursor (gsap quickTo lag). ghost-trail: discrete squares echoing past cursor states, fading out; JS-side palette (#8a6df1 purple) not in CSS.
Both are panel rows. clip-panel-reveal: panels unmask top-down via clip-path on scroll. hover-expand-gallery: pointer hover grows a panel's flex share (neighbours compress).
Shared full-screen stage + ink/bone scaffold. wave-text: ambient ripple travels across text characters. morph-blob: SVG blob breathes through four pose paths (different keyed path commands).
Trail family again. spring-trail: DOM blob, spring physics. gooey-cursor: SVG circles behind an feGaussianBlur+feColorMatrix gooey filter; SVG defs block present only here.

TRUE near-duplicate: same pack2 template (fixed label row + centered square grid + fixed status footer, ui-monospace, --bg/--ink/--hot vars). Differ: 9x9 grid with pointer-proximity distortion + pressure meter vs 8x8 grid with click-toggle disperse/reassemble; --bg #e9e4da vs #f2ede3; cell class names differ (.cell vs .piece).
Cursor family. gooey-cursor: continuous SVG gooey blob. ghost-trail: discrete fading square echoes, no filter.

Buttons with pointer interaction. magnetic-button: cursor proximity pull on the whole button (quickTo), label counter-shift, elastic return; data-magnetic attributes. balloon-button: inflates (scale + border-radius growth) while held/charged; different data attributes.
Text effects on identical scaffold. scramble: lines decode noise-to-message sequentially. wave: ambient ripple ambience.
Word-level text effects. reading-highlight: scroll-driven dim-to-ink word highlighting. wave: ambient ripple.
Shared scaffold only; no structural similarity (word highlighter vs SVG blob) - kept for transparency.
Interactive hover effects. magnetic: proximity pull. line-draw: SVG line path draws on hover over button text.
Scaffold similarity only: morphing SVG blob vs inflating button. Not semantic duplicates.
Gallery-ish rows. hover-expand: pointer-driven flex share. double-slideshow: auto-advancing paired slideshow (ticker).
Both pointer-reactive DOM elements; no semantic overlap (button inflation vs cursor echoes).
Numeric counters. count-up: single value tweens up on enter. odometer-roll: per-digit columns spin from random offsets; different markup (digits split into .digit cells).

findings.detail: benzina-portfolio references --card and --svc which no snippet defines; check whether script.js sets them via setProperty().

draggable-infinite-slider-gsaposmo references --color-black/--color-light/--color-dark/--color-neutral-900/--container-padding/--cubic-default defined only by its external Osmo UI stylesheet (https://slater.app/...). Library cannot render correctly offline.

draggable-infinite-slider-gsaposmo and gsap-grid both use a --color-* namespace for DIFFERENT palettes (--color-black = osmo #000 vs #222222). Promotion to shared tokens.css must resolve this collision first.
Several effects hardcode colors in GSAP targets only (e.g. ghost-trail #8a6df1/#ffc43d/#2fd6c3, spring-trail #c9340e); these never appear in CSS audits and are invisible to CSS-only token extraction.

Every package ships src/ AND dist/ with the same snippet (build artifact copies); benzina also ships dist/website.zip. motion-atlas-creative-53-60.zip duplicates the 8 extracted pack2 files. None auto-merged.
Both motion-atlas packs use index 53: '53-gait-locomotion' (pack 1) vs '53-magnetic-fracture' (pack 2). Content differs; name collision only.
